text:
Maria S: Uploading draft capability matrix + RFI answers for Solaris. Need pricing bands for the POC and confirmation on HSM/KMS language. Sharing links and attachments below. Can we share these with the customer? (attachments: capability_matrix_solaris_v1.xlsx, rfi_answers_solaris.pdf) https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link
Jordan P: Quick skim — looks good. A couple rows under 'model variants' need 95th pct latency numbers before we send.
Alex K: I can add latency numbers. Which instance type are we proposing for the POC — A100-80GB dedicated or a mixed burst config?
Maria S: Recommend 2x A100-80GB dedicated for baseline, allow burst to T4s for demo traffic. POC duration: 4 weeks.
Priya R: Draft pricing bands (need finance sign-off):
```
POC pricing (est):
- Eval (2 A100, 4 wks): $24,000
- Pilot (2 A100 + burst): $40,000/month
- Prod reserved (4 A100): $120,000/month (committed)
```
Samir V: @Maria S heads up — we can't promise on-prem HSM during an initial cloud POC unless customer signs the Private deployment addendum. For hosted POC we support CMEK (customer-managed keys) via AWS/GCP KMS. Add that note to RFI.
Maria S: Added language in rfi_answers_solaris.pdf (lines 42-56): "CMEK via AWS KMS; HSM options available under Private deployment subject to contract addendum."
SecOps Bot: Automated scan: rfi_answers_solaris.pdf checked — no PHI detected; PII low. Passed basic security check.
Alex K: Jordan — can you paste the latency numbers so I can drop them into the matrix?
Jordan P: Done. Inserted 95th pct latency for 512 tokens: 120ms on A100, ~45ms on T4-burst. Note: int8 quantized builds add ~10% latency.
Priya R: Customer also asked about SLA: they require 99.9% monthly uptime and 4hr response for Sev1. Can we commit that for POC or pilot? @Samir V
Samir V: 99.9% is achievable but only on Dedicated with SLA add-on. Hosted default is 99.5%. Legal needs to sign off on SLA wording and penalties. I'll loop in legal.
Maria S: Another enterprise blocker: customer requested SOC2 + FedRAMP attestation timeline. We need to be explicit in the response.
Samir V: We have SOC2 Type II report available now. We don't host FedRAMP. Recommend offering Private deployment + partner guidance for FedRAMP workloads; estimate 3–6 months to pursue.
Priya R: I'm drafting the official RFP reply now. Will attach: capability_matrix_solaris_v1.xlsx, rfi_answers_solaris_signed.pdf, poc_pricing_estimate.csv and send to customer by EOD.
Jordan P: :thumbsup: Standing by for the final matrix.
Maria S: Customer follow-up: they asked if POC can start on 2026-03-30. @Priya R can you confirm schedule?
Priya R: Confirmed — kickoff scheduled 2026-03-30 09:00 PT. Calendar invite sent to Solaris.
DeployBot: Provisioning notice: tenant-solaris provisioning request created (#req-8847).
Maria S: Thanks all — will close this thread after Priya posts final attachments.
